notes: Vinyl or aluminium lap siding, the surface the late 1990s put over older Delco houses (docs/DELCO_1997_ART_DIRECTION.md point 5). `form_lines` and not `masonry`: a lap course is one continuous board with a shadow line under its butt edge and no vertical joint. 12 courses on a 2.5 m tile is a 21 cm exposure, a double-4 profile. The warp at 90 degrees is the sag a long vinyl run takes; without it the courses are a ruler.
